QuestInfo.name: The Price of Fear
QuestInfo.0: Worried for the people of his village, Gared asks you to keep an eye on Edward. He wants to be sure both that the boy doesn't escape, and that he is protected from any villagers hoping to take advantage of the chaos and deal with the Snow Child for good.\r\nOn the way to the storeroom, you encounter a different problem...
